svg.text: 8-neighbor finite-domain ensemble · frozen B/E states
All finite lobes shown with one shared boundary style; gray = B on fixed 0–1 scale, pale tint = E, dots = F, amber = selected I, white line = principal path. No rank coloring.
Full 96×96 frame in every panel. I is a reference overlay; domain membership is a mathematical organization of B within E.
